Apple smb-348.7, commit 91f35b3eb0b2445137005c97a04da6482e0c2a11
https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/smb/tree/smb-348.7

Original source and notices copied directly, without a Git submodule.
The original smbfs1.4.6 metadata matches the native Leopard9L31a client.

Purpose: narrow native Darwin9 SMB client compatibility, preserving the
original filesystem, password ioctl, Finder integration, transport and explicit
Kerberos/gssd path. No replacement host server, authentication proxy, guest
password database, userland injection or global host-security change.

The BSD-2-Clause vim_ntlmssp_wire files are shared unchanged with the vendored
Tiger client. vim_ntlmssp_native uses that codec with Darwin9's own Unicode,
MD4/MD5/random/time APIs and opaque KPI mbufs. The original password path
negotiates Unicode and extended security at the wire boundary, then owns the
NTLMv2/SPNEGO handshake, key exchange, transcript/mechanism MIC and signed SMB
requests/replies. Explicit Kerberos callers keep their original implementation.
Named transactions retain Unicode when this native NTLMSSP path is selected.
A read-only net.smb.fs.vim_client=2 identifies the resident custom client.

Initial qualification: all31 source-phase units compile and the i386 native
relocatable links with actual10.5 SDK, Apple GCC4.2 and Darwin9 XNU headers.
The real9L31a guest's kextload -n -t accepts the private bundle. Its private
load, native11-share listing, native mount/read/write/Unicode-name round trip
and the production app's Open in Finder/native public-share mount pass.
Apple's system kext is unchanged. Normal cold boot and repeat repair also
pass with the production app/helper; this does not qualify every Leopard
build, a fresh OS install or ARM host.
